adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new deleteEvent logic computes `calendarId` as:

```ts
const calendarId = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is missing/undefined, the fallback searches for a destination calendar whose `externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined`), which will almost always find nothing, making `calendarId` undefined. The code also defines `defaultCalendarId = "primary"`, so this will cause a fallback to primary (and thus potentially delete/update the wrong calendar) instead of using the intended destination calendar from `event.destinationCalendar` (e.g., the first/main one).
